calibration_note: Sensitivity-only reference curve. Not calibrated to Taiwan, Chiayi, Taipower, or the synthetic IEEE-33 feeder. Replace or fit with local component failure and wind observations before interpreting as empirical probabilities.
source_reference: Literature-reported empirical pole failure equation: p_pole = 0.0001 * exp(0.0421 * V_mph); see the cited distribution resilience study and its underlying reference. Implemented in mph as stated in the source equation.
branch_geometry_note: Branch lengths are straight-line distances between synthetic bus sample points, not surveyed conductor route lengths. Pole counts are illustrative assumptions.
